<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Delete a timeless account</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"delete"} path={"/v1/timeless-indices/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Deletes a timeless account and returns the deleted timeless account.

A timeless account can't be deleted while optimizers write into it. Delete those optimizers first: [List the optimizers that write into a timeless account](https://api-docs.logz.io/docs/logz/list-optimizers-of-timeless-account) returns them.

An account can't delete its last timeless account: the request returns 400 while it's the only one.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
